source: LYNX MCP tools/list schema observed in this integration; no device/session data

tools.name: lynx_download_firmware
tools.description: Download a firmware artifact selected by the remote AI from the saved SDK channel's Linux host into LYNX's automatic per-channel firmware cache through SFTP. Pass remotePath as the exact absolute Linux file path. LYNX always verifies SHA-256, reuses a matching cached file, and writes new content through a .part file before atomic rename.

projectId.description:
Saved SDK channel project ID. May be omitted for a device-scoped Gateway
when exactly one saved project belongs to that device.

remotePath.description: Absolute firmware path selected by the remote AI on the SDK host.

tools.name: lynx_flash_capabilities
tools.description: Describe the chip vendor, flasher backend, target binding, and validated flash options for this LYNX board channel.

tools.name: lynx_inspect_firmware
tools.description: Inspect a firmware image with the current board channel's vendor adapter. This is read-only.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a vendor firmware image on the LYNX host.

tools.name: lynx_scan_flash_devices
tools.description: Scan the board-scoped vendor flasher for connected devices. Supports Allwinner FEL/FES, Rockchip Maskrom/Loader, NXP i.MX SDP/Fastboot, Canaan Kendryte K230 BROM/U-Boot, and STM32 USB DFU/DfuSe.

tools.name: lynx_start_flash
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: flash this channel's bound board through its configured vendor adapter. Allwinner loaderPath is RAM-only: use a component package with mode=full_erase for initial NAND/SPI NAND layout creation, or raw=true and mode=command for SPI NOR, SD/SD NAND, eMMC and UFS. Query lynx_flash_capabilities first.

allowUnverifiedSerialShell.description: Pass the same explicit fixed-recipe override as lynx_allwinner_enter_fel.

handle.description: Handle returned by lynx_serial_open. Required for either serial recipe.

method.description: Fixed transition recipe. No caller-provided command text is accepted.

preserveSerialMonitor.description:
Keep the bound serial reader open while the flash worker boots vendor
U-Boot/FES so the caller can collect boot diagnostics. Opt-in only.

mode.description: Backend-defined flash mode advertised by lynx_flash_capabilities.

postFlashAction.description: Backend-defined post-flash action advertised by lynx_flash_capabilities.

vendorOptions.description:
Backend-specific object validated against lynx_flash_capabilities.vendorOptions.
Rockchip raw eMMC: {"raw":true,"loaderPath":"/local/loader.bin","medium":"emmc"}; firmwarePath accepts .img/.img.xz/.img.gz. Requires full_erase and verification.

handle.description: A current lynx_serial_open handle belonging to this board; serial recipe only.

allowFullSpeedLargeImage.description:
Explicitly allow a large Allwinner image over a USB Full Speed FEL link.
This is intentionally separate from confirmDestructive because the transfer
may be slow or time out even when the selected target and image are correct.

allwinnerEnterFel.description:
Optional fixed Allwinner transition recipe. When present, LYNX enters
FEL and starts flashing under one uninterrupted hardware guard.

confirmDestructive.description: The AI's in-band acknowledgement that the selected operation is destructive.

firmwarePath.description: Absolute path to the vendor firmware package on the LYNX host.

options.description: Optional backend-neutral and vendor-specific choices. Query lynx_flash_capabilities first.

rockchipEnterLoader.description: Fixed Rockchip normal-to-Loader recipe; shares the flash hardware guard.

tools.name: lynx_workbench_task_status
tools.description: Read the current status of an asynchronous LYNX workbench task such as an SFTP firmware download.
